links.effect: Weighted sensitivity 93.2% (95% CI 88.8–97.8%), specificity 99.7%, PPV 80.7%; no clinician-rated Immediate-risk conversation completely missed.
links.quote: Among conversations clinicians judged to contain actionable suicide risk, the safety agent correctly escalated 93.2% of them (95% CI, 88.8–97.8%; weighted sensitivity).

links.outcome: Missed and unnecessary escalations of suicide-risk conversations
links.effect: No Immediate-risk conversations missed; few Non-Immediate under-classified by one level; 99.7% correctly not escalated; 80.7% of escalations confirmed warranted; 4-level agreement 95.5% (weighted κ 0.72).
links.quote: Critically, no clinician-rated Immediate-risk conversation was completely missed by the agent and only a small number of Non-Immediate-risk conversations were under-classified by one severity level.
